details: As part of the Aquiweb development team, built and deployed full-stack features used by 100+ shop-floor users and approximately 20 managers, supporting production, inventory, and equipment workflows.
Developed new backend functionality and adapted existing features to client-specific business logic and manufacturing processes.
Created and modified frontend workflows and interfaces for users of an enterprise Manufacturing Execution System (MES).
Built REST API integrations and data import/export workflows, including work-order imports connecting Aquiweb with APIs and other software.

Built a CSV import workflow that processed 20,000+ complex operations across multiple work orders, some with hundreds of operations. Added validation, post-import processing, and dependency creation, with transactional rollback to prevent partial imports.
Implemented process validations for required quantities and available stock, including a rule that prevented reporting material consumption above available inventory.
Worked on manufacturing and inventory processes involving production recording, material consumption, stock use, handling units, and equipment-specific behavior.
Generated client-specific reports with JasperReports.
Investigated production issues using logs, SQL queries, and user workflows; reproduced problems, traced causes, tested fixes, and supported releases.
Participated in unit, functional, and regression testing, code reviews, technical documentation, and GitLab/Jenkins CI/CD workflows for builds, integrations, deployments, and production validation.
Collaborated with developers, functional consultants, clients, and other stakeholders to clarify requirements and deliver features for specific users and processes.
Participated in sprint planning and estimation using Planning Poker.
Used OpenAI Codex to understand the codebase, debug issues, support testing and documentation, and explore solutions.
Customized and maintained Sage X3 ERP functionality using Sage X3 4GL and SQL, primarily in a client-consulting context.
Adapted existing ERP behavior and functionality to client requirements and workflows.
Investigated application and database issues, reproduced defects, tested changes, and supported technical troubleshooting.
Worked directly with English- and French-speaking clients to clarify requirements and validate solutions.
Created and maintained client-specific Crystal Reports, including formulas, conditional logic, parameters, formatting, and subreports.

Streamlined an internal administrative process for 40+ employees by designing and implementing an automated workflow using a shared spreadsheet and Power Automate. Replaced manual data collection with automated tracking, reminders, and weekly resets. The solution remained in use for over 3 years.
Built a Node.js prototype integrated with the Sage X3 REST API to retrieve manufacturing order data and display it in a web interface with a weekly calendar.
Developed and debugged mobile game functionality using C# and Unity.
Participated in Agile development, testing, QA, bug tracking, documentation, and release validation.
Served as acting Scrum Master for a small mobile game development team, supporting sprint planning, task coordination, communication, and estimation using Planning Poker.

education.program: DEC in Computer Techniques: New Media Programming
details: Graduated at the top of the class with a 94% weighted average.
Coursework covered web development, JavaScript, Node.js, databases, object-oriented programming, and other areas of the program.
Selected as one of two students out of a class of 15 to tutor classmates in C++ for one semester. The sessions received very positive feedback from participants and helped improve the class average.
Completed hands-on Arduino coursework and built small personal Arduino projects.
Received a research scholarship for two consecutive semesters.
Participated in a Junior Enterprise focused on business consulting and strategic planning.
Completed a student exchange at Université du Québec à Montréal (UQAM).
Completed coursework in data structures, algorithms, C, C++, object-oriented programming, and databases.
Tutored fellow students in C programming for two semesters.
Selected by my Logic and Algorithms professor as one of two students out of 50 to compete in an ICPC programming contest.
Helped deliver introductory logic-programming workshops for high school students.
